project.title: Cross-Depot Safe Handling and Loading Process Upgrade
project.objective: Standardise and improve how goods are packed, moved, and stored across depots to reduce damage, delays, and safety incidents.
deliverables: Standard operating procedure for packing, loading, and unloading
Depot storage layout and shelf labelling plan
Training checklist for movers and support staff
Pilot run report with KPIs on damage and delay reduction
constraints: All changes must fit existing vehicles and storage equipment
No disruption to daily delivery schedule beyond short pilots
Compliance with transport and workplace safety regulations
Limited budget for new tools and materials
Documentation must be simple enough for on-site staff to use

risks.risk: Staff resist new loading and packing routines.
risks.mitigation: Involve movers and depot staff in defining steps and run short pilots with feedback.

risks.risk: New process slows down loading and causes delays.
risks.mitigation: Time each step during pilot, remove non-essential checks, and adjust staffing where needed.

risks.risk: Storage layout changes cause misplaced items.
risks.mitigation: Introduce clear shelf labelling, simple maps, and a short on-floor orientation session.

risks.risk: Safety rules are not consistently followed on busy days.
risks.mitigation: Create a concise safety checklist and assign shift-level safety champions to monitor use.

themes.why_relevant: Core to reducing injuries and damage while keeping loading times acceptable.
Consistent packing reduces breakage and makes stacking and transport more efficient.

themes.theme: Depot storage layout and shelf use
themes.why_relevant: Better layout and labelling help movers and shelf fillers find and stage goods faster.
Some moves involve animals or sensitive items that need specific welfare and safety steps.
Structured reporting of near-misses and damage helps refine the process over time.

backlog.task: Map current loading, unloading, and packing steps across depots
definition_of_done: List of current steps for loading, unloading, and packing is documented
Differences between depots are highlighted
Pain points and frequent issues are captured from at least three movers

backlog.task: Draft standard operating procedure for safe loading and unloading
definition_of_done: Step-by-step SOP for loading and unloading is written
Includes checks for weight distribution and securing loads
Reviewed by at least two movers and the warehouse supervisor

backlog.task: Design improved packing guidelines by type of goods
definition_of_done: Goods categories and recommended packing materials are listed
Guidelines cover fragile, bulky, and hazardous items
Examples with photos or sketches are attached to the guideline

backlog.task: Create depot shelf layout and labelling plan
definition_of_done: Proposed shelf zones and flow paths are documented
Labelling scheme for aisles and shelves is defined
Plan is validated with at least one mover for pick-up efficiency

backlog.task: Define special handling steps for animals and sensitive cargo
definition_of_done: List of animal and sensitive cargo types is created
Handling and welfare requirements are documented
Steps are aligned with relevant animal welfare and transport regulations

backlog.task: Prepare training checklist for movers and depot staff
definition_of_done: Checklist covers SOP, packing, storage layout, and safety rules
Separate sections for new hires and refreshers are included
Reviewed and approved by operations manager or delegate

backlog.task: Set up simple incident and near-miss reporting flow
definition_of_done: Reporting steps and channels are defined
Template for incident details is created
Process is communicated to all movers and depot staff

backlog.task: Run pilot of new loading and packing process on selected routes
definition_of_done: Pilot routes and dates are agreed and documented
New process is followed for at least one week on pilot routes
Feedback and basic metrics on time and damage are collected

backlog.task: Adjust depot storage layout based on pilot feedback
definition_of_done: Feedback on storage layout from movers is reviewed
Concrete layout changes are listed and prioritised
At least one depot implements the updated layout and labels

backlog.task: Document final process and share with all stakeholders
definition_of_done: Final SOP, packing guide, and safety checklist are consolidated
Documents are shared in central repository and announced
Questions from first review round are answered in writing

backlog.task: Define KPIs and simple tracking sheet for damage and delays
definition_of_done: Key indicators for damage, delays, and incidents are defined
Tracking sheet structure is created and tested with sample data
Usage instructions are added to the sheet

backlog.task: Create quick-reference visual aids for depot and vehicle use
definition_of_done: Posters or cards summarising key steps are drafted
Visuals are clear and use minimal text
At least one mover and one shelf filler validate readability

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on current issues and agree on scope and priorities for the upgrade.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message asking everyone to share current loading, packing, and storage pain points.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on the top three issues the project will address first.
Confirm which depots and routes are in scope for the first rollout.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Draft and refine the standard loading, unloading, and packing process.
threads_plan.trigger: Mover shares first draft of the SOP and packing guidelines for review.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the core loading and unloading steps for the SOP.
Agree on packing rules for fragile and bulky items.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define and validate the depot storage layout and labelling approach.
threads_plan.trigger: Shelf filler posts proposed shelf map and labelling scheme for comments.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Select the storage layout and labelling scheme for the pilot depot.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Agree on special handling steps for animals and sensitive cargo.
threads_plan.trigger: Groom shares draft guide for animal and sensitive cargo handling.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve mandatory steps for animal welfare and sensitive cargo handling.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Plan and review the pilot, including training and KPIs.
threads_plan.trigger: Mover proposes pilot routes, training plan, and KPI tracking approach.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm pilot routes, dates, and participating staff.
Agree on KPIs and how often to review the tracking sheet.

channel_rituals: Daily async check-in each morning on planned moves, risks, and support needed.
Twice-weekly short review of incidents and near-misses with quick follow-ups.
Weekly pilot status update summarising KPIs and key feedback from the field.
End-of-project retrospective thread to capture lessons learned and next steps.
